_comment: Fun-density quotas by blueprint size. Source: 10-Fun-Mechanics-and-Content-Organization.md §5, derived from crawl/fun-metrics.json rating-tier aggregates (great(8+) n=4 vs lower tiers) and the phase-⑥ test-game diagnosis (385 upgrades, 88% constant-mult, 0 clickables/bars/microtabs). Mechanics catalog M1-M10 and effect taxonomy K1-K8 are defined in handbook 10. Quotas are FLOORS, not targets - theme fit (P14) decides which mechanics are used.

medium.challengeStyle: M1 classic OR M2 score-attack hub

staticCheckThresholds._comment: READ AT RUN TIME by scripts/static_checks.js. This block is the authority for the D-* thresholds; the literals in the checker are only a fallback for running without the assets folder. microtabsFailAtContentItems is derived as microtabsWarnAtContentItems + 2.
staticCheckThresholds.effectShapeNote: D-EFFECTSHAPE fires when a layer has >=5 effect-bearing upgrades and NONE uses .pow()/.log()/.sqrt()/softcap(). Corpus op frequencies: pow 4,830 / add 3,364 / log10 3,350 / mul 1,652 - power-log shapes outnumber plain multiplies ~3:1.
staticCheckThresholds.costSpanNote: D-COSTSPAN fires when a layer's literal costs span <3 orders of magnitude. Real ladders span 6+ (c0v1d layer 's': 5e3 -> Decimal.pow(10, 545766)). Static layers get a 1-order bar: their currency is a floor COUNT growing as log2(stardust) (reference ladder 1,2,4,8,16,2,8,16,32,48,64 = 1.8 orders), so the 3-order bar would fire on correct shapes.
staticCheckThresholds.localWireNote: D-LOCALWIRE fires when a main layer has >=3 effect-bearing upgrades and its gainMult/gainExp/passiveGeneration/update reference none of them.

corpusEffectShares._source: Full archive of 329 real TMT games, 6,274 effect-bearing upgrades (phase 8, 2026-10-03). E:\Idle-Skill\archive\TMT_生成式AI增量游戏数值设计指南.md section 1.3.
corpusEffectShares.reading: Overlapping shares (one effect can use several ops). The 3:1 pow:times ratio is the design lesson: a layer of flat x2 multipliers reads as unfinished. Target >=30% of a layer's upgrades using a pow/log shape.

effectKinds.K1: flat mult (themed name even so); capped by maxK1SharePerLayer
effectKinds.K4: meta-effect on a NAMED mechanic or resource: rewrites a labelled formula (^1.01-^1.2). Handbook 12: do NOT boost another upgrade's hidden number — the player cannot see or reason about it
effectKinds.K5: softcap/hardcap manipulation: delay cap, raise hardcap, replace formula, reduce cost
effectKinds.K6: conditional: if-chains on progress/other components/challenge state
effectKinds.K7: unlock/gate: no numeric effect, unlocks layer/subtab/buyable/challenge (excluded from K1 quota)
effectKinds.K8: production/conversion: generates a new currency over time

perLayerRule: >=3 distinct non-K1 kinds per layer; rotate K2/K3/K4/K5
